title: Love this toaster oven - perfect for my needs
text: Love this toaster oven - perfect for my needs. Beautiful toaster oven. I love that the door swings up instead of down (like my previous one). Makes it so much easier to remove food without burning my hands. Matches my stainless steel kitchen perfectly. The digital display looks terrific too. Great cooking size, I easily can cook a pizza or even a small roasting chicken with ease. Food cooks quickly and is evenly distributed. I love that for smaller meals I don't need to turn on my full size oven. No complaints, great device if you are looking for a new one for your kitchen.
